name: Complexity Signal Coverage
hypothesis: More than 60% of beads have sufficient signals (EstimatedFileCount, IsLeafBead, IsTestOnlyBead, title patterns) for non-default complexity classification. Logging these signals without changing routing will reveal the actual coverage gap and inform whether scope-first routing is viable.
change: After rebuilding the binary with the existing wiring fix, add observability-only logging of all available complexity signals per bead (file count estimate, leaf status, test-only detection, low-complexity title match, label presence) to iteration logs. No routing changes.
measurement: Percentage of beads with non-default complexity classification; distribution of complexity_source values (scope_estimate vs label vs default); count of beads where 2+ low-complexity signals fire. Target: >60% non-default classification after binary rebuild.
risk: Minimal — observability-only change with no routing impact. The only risk is log volume increase from additional fields.
